system.description:
You force open your minds 3rd Eye greatly increasing your perceptive abilities 10-fold. This jutsu does not cost chakra to maintain concentration.

When this jutsu is cast, for the duration, you gain access to the Third Eye Opening ability. This counts as a Constitution and Wisdom based Skill-Action.

Third Eye Opening. As a Bonus action, you open your third eye gaining 120ft of Chakra sight, Chakra Sensing and the following benefits;

You can identify if a creature, object or structure has been affected by a jutsu within the last 24 hours.

Advantage on the See Through lies skill action.

You can see if chakra has been used within the past 24 hours and can associate it with a creature if you have sensed them before. You can track creatures exclusively by their chakra alone.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the range of Third Eye Opening’s special senses to 1-Mile and the duration of this jutsu becomes Concentration, up to 10 minutes. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, it no longer requires concentration.
